## Problem

A clear and concise description of the problem this feature would solve.

Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered?

## Use Case

Who would use this feature? (individual developer, team lead, enterprise)

**Frequency**: How often would you use this? (daily, weekly, monthly)

## Additional Context

Screenshots, mockups, examples from other tools, etc.

---

**Checklist**:
- [ ] I have searched existing issues and discussions
- [ ] I have checked the roadmap to see if this is planned
- [ ] I have explained the problem clearly (not just the solution)
